items.name: Audio Recorder Engine V2
items.title: Audio Recorder Engine V2
items.description:
# Audio Recorder Engine V2

**Capture high-quality microphone audio with flexible recording modes and automation-ready output.**

Audio Recorder Engine is a professional recording engine for **Core Factory V2** that allows you to capture audio directly from any available microphone and save it as high-quality WAV files.

Designed for automation as well as manual recording, the engine supports one-time recordings, countdown recording, and scheduled recording cycles, making it suitable for voiceovers, podcasts, interviews, AI datasets, meeting notes, testing, and production workflows.

---

# Key Features

## High-Quality Audio Recording

Record directly from your microphone with configurable audio settings.

Supported options include:

* Mono or Stereo recording
* Multiple sample rates
* Multiple PCM formats
* Custom input buffer size
* WAV output format

Produce clean, uncompressed audio suitable for editing, transcription, or AI processing.

---

## Multiple Recording Modes

Choose the recording workflow that best fits your needs.

### Manual Mode

Start recording after an optional countdown, giving you time to prepare before capture begins.

### One-Time Recording

Automatically record for a predefined duration and stop when finished.

Ideal for interviews, voice notes, and quick recordings.

### Cycle Recording

Automatically perform repeated recordings at fixed time intervals.

Perfect for:

* Environmental monitoring
* Scheduled voice capture
* Automated testing
* Long-term recording tasks

---

## Flexible Audio Configuration

Configure recording parameters to match your project requirements.

Available settings include:

* Recording duration
* Countdown timer
* Recording interval
* Maximum recording cycles
* Sample rate
* Audio channels
* PCM sample format
* Input block size
* Output filename template

---

## Microphone Device Selection

Select either:

* The system default microphone
* A specific recording device
* A device index
* A device name

The engine automatically validates microphone availability before recording begins to prevent failed jobs.

---

## Smart Output Management

Generate organized recordings with customizable filenames.

Features include:

* Timestamp-based filenames
* Date and time variables
* Optional overwrite protection
* Automatic output folder opening
* Structured execution results

---

## Automation Ready

Audio Recorder Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Captured audio can be passed directly into downstream engines for:

* Speech-to-Text
* AI Transcription
* Translation
* Audio Analysis
* Content Generation
* Meeting Summaries
* Voice Processing
* Dataset Preparation

No manual file handling is required.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Podcast recording
* Voice-over production
* AI speech datasets
* Meeting recordings
* Interview capture
* Voice memos
* Audio testing
* Accessibility workflows
* Automated monitoring
* Research projects

---

# Reliable Recording

Designed for dependable operation during both manual and automated workflows.

Features include:

* Recording progress reporting
* Cancellation support
* Input device validation
* Stable worker-process execution
* Structured execution logs
* Machine-readable results for Pipelines

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* Windows-compatible audio input device
* A working microphone
* SoundDevice audio runtime

---

# Why Choose Audio Recorder Engine?

Most recording applications focus on manual audio capture.

Audio Recorder Engine goes further by combining professional recording capabilities with automation, scheduling, and seamless integration into larger workflows.

Whether you're building AI datasets, recording voice content, automating repetitive audio capture, or creating production pipelines, Audio Recorder Engine provides a reliable and scalable recording solution inside the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Podcasters
* AI Developers
* Researchers
* Software Testers
* Business Teams
* Educators
* Anyone who needs reliable microphone recording with automation support

Capture once, schedule forever, and integrate every recording into your automated workflows with Audio Recorder Engine V2.

items.name: File Organization Engine V2
items.title: File Organization Engine V2
items.description:
# File Organization Engine V2

**Rename thousands of files and organize entire folders in minutes.**

File Organization Engine is a powerful automation engine for **Core Factory V2** that helps you clean up messy folders, standardize filenames, and automatically organize files into structured directories.

Whether you're managing media libraries, project assets, downloaded files, engineering documents, or large datasets, this engine eliminates repetitive manual work with safe, repeatable automation.

---

# Key Features

## Batch File Renaming

Rename hundreds or thousands of files in a single operation.

Supported methods include:

* Simple Base Name
* Custom Filename Templates
* Automatic Numbering
* Find & Replace
* Regular Expression (Regex)
* Letter Case Conversion
* Configurable Number Padding

Example:

```
IMG_8391.jpg
IMG_8392.jpg
IMG_8393.jpg

↓

Vacation_001.jpg
Vacation_002.jpg
Vacation_003.jpg
```

---

## Smart Folder Organization

Automatically organize files into structured folders.

Supported organization modes:

* By File Extension
* By Year
* By Month
* By First Letter

Example:

```
Downloads/

↓

Images/
Videos/
Documents/
Archives/
```

or

```
Photos/

↓

2026/
   January/
   February/
   March/
```

---

## Recursive Processing

Process an entire directory tree with a single operation.

The engine can automatically include subfolders, making it ideal for organizing large projects without manually selecting each folder.

---

## Safe Preview Mode

Preview every planned operation before making any changes.

Dry Run mode lets you verify rename and organization results without modifying your files.

Perfect for large collections where safety is important.

---

## Flexible Rename Rules

Choose the naming style that fits your workflow.

Supported options include:

* Sequential numbering
* Original filename tokens
* File extension tokens
* Search & Replace
* Regex patterns
* Uppercase / Lowercase conversion

---

## Reliable Batch Processing

Designed for large-scale automation.

Features include:

* Continue on Error
* Progress Reporting
* Filename Conflict Handling
* Structured Execution Reports
* Pipeline Integration

The engine continues processing remaining files even if individual items fail (when enabled).

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Organize Download folders
* Rename camera photos
* Standardize engineering documents
* Prepare AI training datasets
* Clean up project assets
* Organize media libraries
* Archive completed projects
* Prepare files for cloud storage

---

# Pipeline Ready

File Organization Engine integrates directly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

It is commonly used before engines such as:

* File Transfer
* Image Processing
* OCR
* AI Analysis
* Metadata Processing
* Upload Automation

Its structured output makes it easy to build reliable multi-step automation workflows.

---

# Why Choose File Organization Engine?

Manually renaming and organizing files is repetitive, slow, and prone to mistakes.

File Organization Engine automates the entire process while giving you complete control over naming rules, folder structures, and execution behavior.

Whether you're managing hundreds or hundreds of thousands of files, the engine provides a fast, safe, and repeatable way to keep everything organized.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Photographers
* Engineers
* AI Developers
* Media Teams
* Businesses
* Archivists
* Anyone managing large collections of files

Save hours of manual work by transforming chaotic folders into clean, consistent, and well-organized file libraries with just a few clicks.

items.name: File Transfer Engine V2
items.title: File Transfer Engine V2
items.description:
# File Transfer Engine V2

Move and organize large collections of files safely and automatically.

The **File Transfer Engine** is a high-performance automation engine for **Core Factory V2**, designed to move files from one location to another while intelligently organizing them into structured folders. It is ideal for users who regularly manage media libraries, downloaded assets, project files, or large datasets.

Unlike a basic file mover, this engine can automatically classify files into **Video**, **Image**, and **Other** categories, preserve the original folder hierarchy, filter short videos, resolve filename conflicts, and generate detailed execution reports for use inside automation pipelines.

---

## Key Features

* Move files and folders with high performance
* Recursive processing of entire directory trees
* Automatically classify files into:

  * Video
  * Image
  * Other
* Preserve original folder structure
* Filter videos by duration
* Process only short videos or exclude them
* Intelligent filename conflict handling

  * Rename
  * Overwrite
  * Skip
* Detailed execution report and processing log
* Progress reporting for long-running jobs
* Supports cancellation during execution
* Fully compatible with Core Factory V2 Pipelines

---

## Typical Use Cases

* Organize downloaded media collections
* Prepare datasets for AI training
* Clean up mixed folders containing images, videos, and documents
* Archive completed projects
* Build structured media libraries
* Batch organize thousands of files before further processing
* Prepare input folders for downstream Core Factory engines

---

## Engine Settings

The engine provides configurable options including:

* Recursive folder scanning
* Preserve folder hierarchy
* Video duration filtering
* File conflict policy
* Continue on error
* Dry Run mode (simulation)
* Include and exclude filename patterns

These settings allow the engine to adapt to both simple and enterprise-scale workflows.

---

## Pipeline Ready

File Transfer Engine integrates seamlessly with the Core Factory V2 automation system.

It can be used as the first stage of a processing pipeline before engines such as:

* Media Analysis
* Media Transcode
* Split & Merge
* Watermark
* AI Processing
* Upload Automation

Each execution produces structured output and reports that can be consumed directly by downstream pipeline stages.

---

## System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
* FFprobe (required only when using video duration filtering)

---

## License

A valid Core Factory V2 license is required to unlock the full version.

Trial mode is supported according to the current Core Factory licensing policy.

---

## Why Choose File Transfer Engine?

Managing thousands of files manually is slow, repetitive, and error-prone.

File Transfer Engine automates the entire workflow with reliable, repeatable, and pipeline-ready processing—making it an essential utility for content creators, AI developers, media professionals, and anyone working with large collections of files every day.

items.name: Media Split & Merge Engine V2
items.title: Media Split & Merge Engine V2
items.description:
# Media Split & Merge Engine V2

**Split large media files into smaller segments or merge multiple videos into a single production-ready file—all with automated batch processing.**

Media Split & Merge Engine is a professional media processing engine for **Core Factory V2** that simplifies one of the most common video workflows: dividing long recordings into manageable clips or combining multiple media files into a single output.

Powered by FFmpeg, the engine supports both video and audio files while preserving folder structures, processing entire directory trees, and integrating seamlessly into automation pipelines.

---

# Key Features

## Split Large Media Files

Automatically divide long videos or audio recordings into smaller segments.

Features include:

* Fixed segment duration
* Batch splitting
* Recursive folder processing
* Automatic output folder creation
* Folder structure preservation
* High-speed FFmpeg processing

Perfect for preparing content for social media, cloud uploads, archives, or downstream editing.

---

## Merge Multiple Media Files

Combine multiple media files into one continuous output.

Supported merge modes:

### Per Folder

Merge all compatible media files inside each folder into a single output.

Ideal for project-based organization.

### Global Merge

Combine every compatible media file from all selected folders into one final video.

Perfect for creating compilations or complete archives.

---

## Intelligent File Ordering

Ensure media is merged in the correct sequence.

Choose between:

* Natural filename order
* Original filesystem order

This helps maintain the intended playback sequence without manually rearranging files.

---

## Flexible Video Encoding

Select the encoding strategy that best matches your workflow.

Supported output codecs include:

* Stream Copy (no re-encoding)
* H.264
* HEVC (H.265)

Use **Stream Copy** for maximum speed or re-encode when compatibility or compression is required.

---

## Optimized for Streaming

Enable **Fast Start** to optimize MP4 files for web playback.

This moves video metadata to the beginning of the file, allowing faster playback on websites and streaming platforms.

---

## Batch Processing

Process hundreds or thousands of files automatically.

Features include:

* Multiple input folders
* Recursive scanning
* Extension filtering
* Preserve folder hierarchy
* Continue processing on errors
* Optional source deletion after successful processing

Designed for production-scale media libraries.

---

## Smart Output Management

Generate clean, organized outputs with configurable options.

Features include:

* Custom output filenames
* Configurable split folder suffixes
* Automatic overwrite handling
* Structured execution reports
* Processing logs

Every operation produces machine-readable results for downstream automation.

---

## Automation Ready

Media Split & Merge Engine integrates directly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Typical downstream workflows include:

* Aspect Ratio Conversion
* Watermark Processing
* Subtitle Generation
* AI Video Analysis
* Video Compression
* Upload Automation
* Social Media Publishing

No manual exporting or file management is required.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Split long recordings into smaller clips
* Prepare videos for YouTube Shorts or TikTok
* Merge camera recordings
* Combine training videos
* Assemble podcast episodes
* Create highlight compilations
* Archive surveillance recordings
* Build AI video datasets
* Organize media libraries

---

# Reliable Media Processing

Designed for long-running, high-volume media workflows.

Features include:

* Worker-process execution
* Progress monitoring
* Cancellation support
* Structured JSON reports
* Predictable batch processing
* Continue-on-error execution
* Folder hierarchy preservation

Large media collections can be processed safely and efficiently with minimal manual intervention.

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* FFmpeg
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

# Why Choose Media Split & Merge Engine?

Splitting and merging media files manually is time-consuming, repetitive, and difficult to scale.

Media Split & Merge Engine automates the entire process with professional FFmpeg-powered processing, intelligent folder management, and seamless integration into larger automation workflows.

Whether you're preparing content for social media, building video archives, assembling media projects, or creating automated production pipelines, this engine delivers fast, reliable, and repeatable results.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Video Editors
* Marketing Teams
* Media Agencies
* AI Developers
* Educators
* Businesses
* Anyone managing large collections of video or audio files

Split smarter. Merge faster. Automate everything with Media Split & Merge Engine V2.

Whether you're creating tutorials, documenting software, recording gameplay, capturing automated tests, or generating AI datasets, the engine delivers reliable recording with seamless automation.

Full desktop recording



High frame-rate capture



Configurable FPS



Adjustable output quality



Efficient video encoding



Low-overhead screen capture

Designed for long recording sessions while maintaining stable performance.

Choose the recording workflow that best fits your project.





Manual recording



One-time recording



Fixed-duration recording



Scheduled recording



Automated pipeline execution
